title: A masjid prayer timetable (printed or on screen)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y4 lessons 78, 80 (A masjid prayer timetable (printed or on screen))
intro: To understand how to use a.m. and p.m. with 12-hour digital times

questions.model: Teacher: bedtime is in the evening, after midday: p.m.

questions.q: School lesson at 9:00: a.m. or p.m.?
Is 11:59 a.m. before or after midday?
Label a.m. or p.m.: wake up 6:45; Asr 5:30; Isha 10:45
How long from 10:30 a.m. to 1:15 p.m.?
Write your school day: lessons at 9:00 a.m., lunch at 12:15 p.m., end at 3:30 p.m.
Why can 24-hour time not use a.m. or p.m.?
questions.a: Every hour has its own number, so it is never unclear

questions.q: Midday is... A) 12:00 p.m. B) 12:00 a.m.
Big question: how do we know morning or evening?
questions.a: a.m. is before midday, p.m. is after midday

questions.q: Big question: why do trains and planes use it?
questions.a: No mix-up between morning and evening
